description: Norris Clinic Cosmetic Dermatology/Urology/Regenerative Medicine in Osaka Tennoji/Namba. We are located 4 minutes walk from Uehonmachi, Osaka and 7 minutes from Tanimachi 9-chome, and are open on Saturdays and Sundays as well.
